# Cozy Checkout — Copilot instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. It is the single
source of truth for repository-wide project, architecture, business, UI, testing
and framework rules, and applies to all work in this repository.

Whenever you make substantial changes during development, review and update
`AGENTS.md` in the same change so it describes the current implementation and
workflow. Keep this file aligned with it; update this reference or any
Copilot-specific guidance when affected. Shared rules belong in `AGENTS.md`
rather than being duplicated here.
